description: Derive provider-neutral execution, context, parallel-safety, and repository-reasoning hints from a plan without invoking models or subagents. Pass an existing plan/v1 or project-test-plan/v1 artifact, or pass repoRoot to derive hints for the project-aware plan of that repository.

changedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative source paths to limit target selection.

excludeProjectRoots.description: Optional project roots or subtree patterns such as examples/** to exclude before planning.

goarch.description: Explicit GOARCH for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

goos.description: Explicit GOOS for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

tags.description: Optional custom Go build tags passed to the target-aware verification command.

itemId.description: Optional stable plan item or project item id to select.

plan.description: A plan/v1 or project-test-plan/v1 artifact. Omit it and pass repoRoot to plan the repository instead.

repoRoot.description: Repository root to audit and plan instead of passing plan.

swiftSchemes.description: Optional shared Xcode scheme per Swift project root. Keys are detected project roots.

name: get_plan_execution_hints

outputSchema.description: Top-level shape of this artifact. The complete contract is schemas/plan-execution-hints-v1.schema.json in the published package.

title: Get Plan Execution Hints
